english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a lack of success or an unsuccessful outcome.
Use 失敗 as the all-purpose noun for a defeat or loss when no narrower contest wording is needed.

examples.english: This exam was another failure for me.
examples.traditional: 今次考試係我又一次嘅失敗。
examples.jyutping: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 hai6 ngo5 jau6 jat1 ci3 ge3 sat1 baai6

examples.english: This defeat in the exam left me really disappointed.
examples.traditional: 今次考試嘅失敗，搞到我好失望。
examples.jyutping: gam1 ci3 haau2 si2 ge3 sat1 baai6 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 hou2 sat1 mong6
